title: ML Starter
description: PyTorch + scikit-learn baseline for general machine-learning work. The torch wheel is auto-matched to the detected CUDA runtime (cuXXX when an NVIDIA GPU is present, CPU/MPS otherwise).

packages.name: torch
packages.note: wheel auto-matched to CUDA (cuXXX) when a GPU is detected

postNotes: torch was resolved to the CUDA-matched wheel when an NVIDIA GPU was detected, else the CPU/MPS build.
Open a notebook with `jupyter lab` once the env is bound as your interpreter.
